nodes.name: 01_foundation.sql
nodes.summary: SETURA foundation migration: creates core enums (user_role_type, booking_status, booking_source), helper functions (set_updated_at, prevent_hospital_id_update), and core tables (hospitals, profiles, user_roles, patients, hospital_working_hours, hospital_holidays) with RLS policies. Establishes SECURITY DEFINER auth helpers (current_user_role, is_global_admin, user_has_hospital_access, user_has_hospital_role).
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL with SECURITY DEFINER functions, RLS policies, trigger functions, and CHECK constraints for multi-tenancy.

nodes.name: 02_atomic_token_engine_&_bookings.sql
nodes.summary: Atomic token engine and bookings: creates hospital_daily_counters table, generate_next_token() SECURITY DEFINER function, queue_sessions table, bookings table with full booking lifecycle, booking_events audit table. Includes handle_booking_status_change trigger, create_booking() and advance_queue() RPCs. Adds Realtime publication for bookings/booking_events/queue_sessions.
nodes.languageNotes: Atomic upsert pattern for token generation using ON CONFLICT. Concurrency-safe queue advancement using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

nodes.name: 03_doctorscheduling&slotengine.sql
nodes.summary: Doctor scheduling and slot engine: creates doctor_specializations, doctor_schedules (with btree_gist exclusion constraint for no-overlapping schedules), doctor_schedule_blocks, doctor_leaves (with daterange exclusion), override_type enum, and doctor_availability_overrides tables. Provides is_doctor_available(), get_remaining_token_capacity(), estimate_wait_minutes() SECURITY DEFINER functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PostgreSQL exclusion constraints with btree_gist extension for schedule conflict prevention.

nodes.name: 04_whatsapp_messaging_engine.sql
nodes.summary: WhatsApp messaging engine: creates whatsapp_message_status/direction/template_category enums, whatsapp_templates, whatsapp_conversations, whatsapp_messages, whatsapp_delivery_logs, and whatsapp_webhook_events tables. Provides find_or_create_whatsapp_conversation(), queue_whatsapp_message(), fetch_pending_whatsapp_messages(), handle_whatsapp_delivery_status(), schedule_whatsapp_retry(), register_webhook_event() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
nodes.languageNotes: WhatsApp message status state machine with retry logic (exponential backoff capped at 1440 mins). Idempotent webhook registration.

nodes.name: 05_notification_queue.sql
nodes.summary: Generic notification queue: creates notification_channel/status/priority enums, notification_templates, notification_queue, and notification_deliveries tables. Provides queue_notification(), fetch_pending_notifications(), mark_notification_sent(), schedule_notification_retry() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
nodes.languageNotes: Priority-based notification scheduling with worker-safe SKIP LOCKED pattern.

nodes.name: 06_background_job_queue.sql
nodes.summary: Background job queue: creates job_queue table with job type, payload, status, priority, retry fields. Provides claim_jobs(), complete_job(), fail_job(), get_pending_jobs() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs for worker coordination.
nodes.languageNotes: Job claim pattern with lease-based concurrency control for distributed workers.

nodes.name: 07_settlement_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Settlement engine: creates payment_orders, payment_attempts, payment_ledger, refunds, and settlements tables with full financial audit trail. Provides create_payment_order(), record_payment_attempt(), settle_hospital_payments() SECURITY DEFINER RPCs.
nodes.languageNotes: Financial integrity with ledger entries for every monetary movement. Idempotent payment order creation.

nodes.name: 08_analytics_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Analytics engine: creates analytics tables for tracking booking metrics, queue performance, doctor productivity, and patient flow statistics.

nodes.name: 09_abuse_protection_&_rate_limiting.sql
nodes.summary: Abuse protection and rate limiting: creates rate_limit_config, rate_limit_logs, and api_request_logs tables. Implements per-hospital, per-endpoint rate limiting with configurable thresholds and logging.

nodes.name: 10_audit_&_security_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Audit and security engine: creates audit_events table for immutable audit trail. Provides log_audit_event() and helper functions for tracking all significant system mutations.

nodes.name: 11_realtime_presence_schedule_tasks.sql
nodes.summary: Realtime, presence, and scheduled tasks: configures Supabase Realtime for live updates, adds presence tracking, and scheduled task infrastructure.

nodes.name: 12_hospital_configuration_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Hospital configuration engine: creates configuration tables for per-hospital settings, preferences, and operational parameters.

nodes.name: 13_payment_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Payment engine: integrates Razorpay with payment_orders table, payment_attempts tracking, webhook handling for payment status updates, and refund processing.

nodes.name: 14_dead_letter_queue.sql
nodes.summary: Dead letter queue: creates dead_letter_jobs table for capturing failed jobs that exceeded retry limits, with retention and analysis capabilities.

nodes.name: 15_partitioning_strategy.sql
nodes.summary: Table partitioning strategy: implements range partitioning on time-series tables (bookings, audit_events) for scalability.

nodes.name: 16_idempotency_hardening.sql
nodes.summary: Idempotency hardening: adds idempotency_key columns and unique constraints to key mutation tables. Ensures safe retry behavior for all financial operations.

nodes.name: 17_queue_monitoring_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Queue monitoring engine: creates queue_metrics, queue_health_checks, and SLA monitoring tables for real-time queue performance tracking.

nodes.name: 18_config_versioning_&_rollback.sql
nodes.summary: Configuration versioning and rollback: creates config_versions table and versioning RPCs for safe configuration changes with audit trail.

nodes.name: 19_background_worker_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Background worker engine v2: creates job_queue_v2, worker_registry, worker_leases, and worker_heartbeats tables. Provides claim_jobs_v2(), complete_job_v2(), register_worker(), send_worker_heartbeat() RPCs. Known regression: claim_jobs_v2 does not populate lease_expires_at.
nodes.languageNotes: Lease-based worker coordination replacing v1 claim pattern. Heartbeat mechanism for worker liveness.

nodes.name: 20_presence_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Presence engine: implements real-time presence tracking for active users, doctors, and queue participants.

nodes.name: 21_analytics_rollups.sql
nodes.summary: Analytics rollups: creates materialized views and rollup tables for pre-computed analytics metrics (hourly, daily, weekly aggregations).

nodes.name: 22_partition_automation.sql
nodes.summary: Partition automation: adds automatic partition creation and maintenance for high-volume time-series tables.

nodes.name: 23_retention_&_cleanup_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Data retention and cleanup: creates retention_policies table and cleanup RPCs for managing data lifecycle (soft deletes, archival, purging).

nodes.name: 24_operational-monitoring_engine.sql
nodes.summary: Operational monitoring engine: creates operational_metrics, system_health_checks, and alert_thresholds tables for system observability.

nodes.name: 25_api_idempotency_registry.sql
nodes.summary: API idempotency registry: creates idempotency_keys table for Edge Function-level idempotency with expiration.

nodes.name: 26_migration_metadata_&_registry.sql
nodes.summary: Migration metadata and registry: creates migration_history and schema_version tables for tracking applied migrations and rollback capabilities.
